Google DeepMind's Oct. 27 post introduces ___ 4, a world model that generates audio natively alongside scenes you can explore, in research preview for trusted testers, with SynthID watermarks on all its video and audio
n: A world model builds a place you can walk through and change, with sound and characters that talk back; the post is as clear about what still drifts (object permanence over long sessions, legible text, spatial accuracy) as about what works. Also Oct. 27: Oracle is putting its business applications inside ChatGPT through plugins, and its U.S. customers can buy OpenAI access through the Oracle Marketplace. Oct. 26: Apple's Siri AI added five languages and memory of past conversations, in beta, and Cloudflare published a dated account of a cache bug that put pieces of other customers' answers into 155 responses from one model between Aug. 27 and Sep. 9. When a provider writes up its own failure with dates and numbers, read that document first.
